name: hcapp_authorizeTrackFile
description: Identity check behind the API's ParseTrackFile function (E5.F6.S6): a hare uploading a GPX/TCX/FIT file so the API can read its points back for the run's official trail. The function only READS the file — saving the trail is hcapp_setOfficialTrail, which does the hare/admin check — so a signed-in device is all this asks. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 149, standard token, @param NULL). No permission gate. Returns the authenticated hasher's id so the API can attribute the parse.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device. Default NULL (ValidateAppAuth then answers 'Device not registered', 1449 / errorType 3).

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token (standard, device secret). Default NULL.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: On auth failure only: { success = 0, errorCode, errorType } (1249 invalid token / errorType 1, 1349 device not registered / 3, 1349 signed out / 7 — see ValidateAppAuth), followed by the error detail at index 1.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: 1 invalid token, 3 device not found, 7 signed out.

rowsets.description: Auth failure detail (errorId, errorType, errorCode, errorTitle, errorUserMessage, errorProc). No debugMessage column.

rowsets.name: Authorized
rowsets.description: On success: the authenticated hasher. Mutually exclusive with ErrorEnvelope.

columns.name: userId
columns.description: The calling hasher (HC.Device.UserId resolved by ValidateAppAuth). Emitted as a UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, so the API's JSON carries it lowercase.

sideEffects: None on success. HC.ErrorLog written by ValidateAppAuth on auth failure, and by the CATCH (which then re-raises with THROW rather than returning an envelope).
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
